input.sourceText: When I consider the memories associated with the last day at our old address, there is one object that for me seemed to assume a greater significance than the other things I was engaged in packing. It was a postcard with a sketch of our street on the front. I'd put it in a box with the rest of my papers. At the door, I realised I was going to pass the postbox for the last time. I went back for the card and wrote our new address on it. Until then, I had thought I'd keep it. I posted it to myself on the way to the bus. Two days later it was in the hall at the new place, face down on the mat.
input.requirements: Keep the change of mind in the story and the quiet ending.
